LESSON: PAINTING AND MOSAIC

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.4: Painting and Mosaic

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Painting and Mosaic
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do we use pictures in our daily lives?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify primary and secondary colours on the colour wheel
2. create a mosaic picture to apply the characteristics
3. appreciate painting and mosaic as picture making techniques

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify primary and secondary colours on the colour wheel
• Model 2: create a mosaic picture to apply the characteristics
• Model 3: appreciate painting and mosaic as picture making techniques

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify primary and secondary colours on the colour wheel
2. Practise: create a mosaic picture to apply the characteristics
3. Practise: appreciate painting and mosaic as picture making techniques

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Painting and Mosaic.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.
